summary.text: Thomas D. "Tom" Corbin is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 5, which covers Greenville and Spartanburg Counties, serving since 2013.
He previously served in the S.C. House from 2011 to 2012.

paragraphs.text: Corbin was born on January 11, 1965, in Greenville, and is a businessman.
His official page lists a B.S. from Clemson University in 1987.
He served in the S.C. House in 2011 and 2012 and has been in the Senate since 2013.
His committees are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Finance, Labor, Commerce and Industry, Medical Affairs and Rules.
